about: Every package that may appear in package-lock.json, with why it is there. The gate fails on any name that is not listed, and on any listed name that is no longer used. A trailing * covers one family of platform builds published together with their parent.

packages.electron: The app's shell: Chromium and Node. Ships.
packages.@electron/get: Electron's own downloader for its binary, used once by node_modules/electron/install.js. Build only.
packages.@electron-internal/extract-zip: Unpacks Electron's binary for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.sumchecker: Checks Electron's binary against the checksums in its package, for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.ms: Time formatting for debug. Build only.
packages.env-paths: Cache folder lookup for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.progress: Download progress bar for @electron/get. Build only.
packages.undici-types: Type declarations pulled in by @types/node. Build only.
packages.@types/node: Type declarations for Node (ours, and the copy Electron's own types ask for). Build only.
packages.@typescript/typescript-*: TypeScript's own program, one build per platform; only the one for this machine is installed. Build only.
packages.esbuild: The bundler for main, the preloads and the views. Build only.
packages.@esbuild/*: esbuild's own program, one build per platform; only the one for this machine is installed. Build only.
